CheckRules.title: Check data protection scoring rules
CheckRules.summary: Checks data protection scoring rules. Calling this operation triggers an asynchronous task to check whether your resources meet the requirements of data protection scoring.

CloseBdrcService.title: CloseBdrcService
CloseBdrcService.summary: Shuts down the Backup and Disaster Recovery Center.

DescribeCheckDetails.title: Query data protection rule check results
DescribeCheckDetails.summary: Queries the check results of data protection rules.

DescribeProductDataRedundancyTypeStat.title: Query data redundancy type statistics information
DescribeProductDataRedundancyTypeStat.summary: Queries statistics information on data redundancy types for cloud services.

DescribeProducts.title: Query cloud service protection scores
DescribeProducts.summary: Queries the data protection score status of cloud services.

DescribeRegions.title: Query region list
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the list of regions. BDRC is a centralized service. This operation is used for features that are related to specific regions.

DescribeRules.title: Query data protection scoring rules
DescribeRules.summary: Queries a list of data protection rules.

DescribeTask.title: Query an asynchronous task
DescribeTask.summary: Queries the details of an asynchronous task.

DescribeTasks.title: Query asynchronous task list
DescribeTasks.summary: Queries the list of asynchronous tasks.

DescribeTopRiskyResources.title: Query resources with the highest risks
DescribeTopRiskyResources.summary: Queries the list of resources with the most risks.

DisableCheckProduct.title: Disable data protection scoring for a cloud service
DisableCheckProduct.summary: Disables the data protection scoring for a cloud service.

DisableCheckResource.title: Disable data protection scoring for a resource
DisableCheckResource.summary: Disables the data protection scoring for a resource.

EnableCheckProduct.title: Enable data protection scoring for an Alibaba Cloud service
EnableCheckProduct.summary: Enables the data protection scoring for an Alibaba Cloud service.

EnableCheckResource.title: Enable data protection score for a resource
EnableCheckResource.summary: Enables the data protection score for a single resource.

EnableCrossAccountManagement.title: Enable cross-account management
EnableCrossAccountManagement.summary: Enables cross-account management. Only a BDRC delegated administrator can call this operation. This operation starts the trusted service on the resource directory side.

GetBdrcService.title: Query data disaster recovery center status
GetBdrcService.summary: Queries the status of the Data Disaster Recovery center.

ListCrossAccounts.title: Query cross-account management relationships
ListCrossAccounts.summary: Queries the list of cross-account management relationships.

ListProtectionPolicies.title: Retrieve protection policy list
ListProtectionPolicies.summary: Retrieves a list of protection policies.

ListProtectionPolicyApplications.title: Retrieve protection policy application history
ListProtectionPolicyApplications.summary: Retrieves the application history of a protection policy.

ListResourceCategories.title: Get resource category list
ListResourceCategories.summary: Retrieves the list of resource categories.

OpenBdrcService.title: OpenBdrcService
OpenBdrcService.summary: Enables the Backup and Disaster Recovery Center.

UpdateCrossAccounts.title: Update cross-account governance relationships
UpdateCrossAccounts.summary: Incrementally updates cross-account governance relationships. Only BDRC delegated administrators can call this operation.

UpdateResources.title: Update resources
UpdateResources.summary: Updates the resources. After you call this operation, an asynchronous task is triggered to update your resources and data protection score.
